# Better Dental Marketing (The Dental Marketing Company)

> Data-driven marketing for dental practices. We build predictable patient pipelines through dental SEO, local search visibility, paid ads and conversion tracking down to the booked appointment, so a practice's chair time is booked, not empty.

betterdentalmarketing.com is the landing page for The Dental Marketing Company, a marketing team that works only with dental practices. Every campaign is measured against one question: did it put a patient in the chair?

## What we help dental practices fix

- Unpredictable patient volume: full-funnel campaigns that smooth out seasonal dips and keep the schedule consistently full.
- Wasted ad spend: conversion tracking down to the appointment, so every dollar is accountable and every report is honest.
- Blending in with competitors: positioning and creative built around what makes a practice genuinely different, not a template.
- Being hard to find: making sure the practice shows up in local search results and in trusted patient resources.

## How we work

- HIPAA-conscious campaigns
- Data-driven, transparent monthly reporting
- Built by marketers who know dentistry

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://betterdentalmarketing.com/): overview of services and how to get started
- [Contact](https://betterdentalmarketing.com/#contact): tell us about your practice; we reply within one business day
- [The Dental Marketing Company](https://thedentalmarketingcompany.com): partner with our team for ads, SEO and patient funnel management

## Related resources

- [The Dental C-Suite Podcast](https://thedentalcsuite.com): free conversations on running and growing a modern dental practice, from the business side of the operatory
- [mytoothhurts.ca](https://mytoothhurts.ca/): a free directory that helps patients find a dentist across Canada, with local dentists checked against the provincial register
